
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiaoniu142857/p/20016676" title="发布于 2026-05-11 19:20">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">洛谷-P16434 [APIO 2026 中国赛区] 蛋糕 题解</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>交互题好玩！</p>
<p>看到各测试点限制各不相同，考虑数据点分治。</p>
<h2 id="约定记号">约定记号</h2>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(f(S)=\sum_{i\in S}a_i\)</span>。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="形式化题意">形式化题意</h2>
<p>你需要猜出评测机里一个 <span class="math inline">\([1,W]\)</span> 中的正整数 <span class="math inline">\(d\)</span>。为此你需要构造一个长度 <span class="math inline">\(\le N\)</span>，值域 <span class="math inline">\([1,W+200]\)</span> 的正整数序列。评测机会把该序列排序并把需要猜的数插入到正确位置。</p>
<p>设排序后序列为 <span class="math inline">\(\{a_i\}_{i=0}^m\)</span>。接下来你最多可以询问 <span class="math inline">\(K\)</span> 次。每次询问需要给出两个下标集合 <span class="math inline">\(S_1,S_2\)</span>，满足 <span class="math inline">\(S_1\cap S_2=\varnothing\)</span> 且 <span class="math inline">\(S_1,S_2\subseteq \{0,1,\dots,m\}\)</span>。评测机会返回 <span class="math inline">\(f(S_1)\)</span> 和 <span class="math inline">\(f(S_2)\)</span> 的大小关系。请猜出评测机中的数。</p>
<h2 id="subtask1">Subtask1</h2>
<p>传 <span class="math inline">\((1,2,3,\dots,W)\)</span>。暴力枚举到第一个满足 <span class="math inline">\(a_i=a_{i+1}\)</span> 的位置，则必有 <span class="math inline">\(d=i+1\)</span>。</p>
<h2 id="subtask2">Subtask2</h2>
<p>传序列 <span class="math inline">\((1,2,3)\)</span>。插入 <span class="math inline">\(d\)</span> 排序后，必然有 <span class="math inline">\(a_0=1, a_3=3\)</span>。我们只需比较 <span class="math inline">\(a_0+a_3=4\)</span> 与 <span class="math inline">\(a_1+a_2\)</span> 的大小。具体地：</p>
<ul>
<li>若 <span class="math inline">\(d=1\)</span>：<span class="math inline">\(\{a\}=(1,1,2,3)\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(a_0+a_3&gt;a_1+a_2\)</span></li>
<li>若 <span class="math inline">\(d=2\)</span>：<span class="math inline">\(\{a\}=(1,2,2,3)\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(a_0+a_3=a_1+a_2\)</span></li>
<li>若 <span class="math inline">\(d=3\)</span>：<span class="math inline">\(\{a\}=(1,2,3,3)\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(a_0+a_3&lt;a_1+a_2\)</span></li>
</ul>
<h2 id="subtask3">Subtask3</h2>
<p>注意到 <span class="math inline">\(K=\lceil\log_2 W\rceil\)</span>，考虑二进制拆分，一次询问确定一位。</p>
<p>我们传 <span class="math inline">\((1,2,2^2,2^3,\dots,2^{29})\)</span>。该序列满足 <span class="math inline">\(\sum_{k=0}^{i-1}a_k&lt;a_i\)</span> 的性质。观潮到插入 <span class="math inline">\(d\)</span> 之后，在 <span class="math inline">\(d\)</span> 及其右侧该性质会被破坏。</p>
<p>那么我们从右往左找到最大的满足以上性质的 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span>。那么 <span class="math inline">\(d\)</span> 的第 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 位一定是 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span>。然后依次尝试加上 <span class="math inline">\(2^{i-1},2^{i-2},\dots,1\)</span> 即可确定剩余位。恰好询问 <span class="math inline">\(30\)</span> 次。</p>
<h2 id="subtask4">Subtask4</h2>
<p>如果直接套用 Subtask 3 的做法可以获得 <span class="math inline">\(11\)</span> 分。由于 <span class="math inline">\(2^K&lt;W\)</span>，该做法没有前途。</p>
<p>注意到 <span class="math inline">\(K=\lceil\log_3 W\rceil\)</span>，而 <span class="math inline">\(3^7=2187&lt;W+200\)</span>。这强烈暗示我们采用三分做法，需要一次询问将搜索范围缩小至 <span class="math inline">\(1/3\)</span>。</p>
<p>发现 <span class="math inline">\(N\)</span> 的限制非常宽松。构造序列 <span class="math inline">\((1,2,3,\dots,3^7)\)</span>。注意到，该序列满足性质 <span class="math inline">\(a_i+a_j=a_{i+k}+a_{j-k}\)</span>。</p>
<p>维护 <span class="math inline">\(d\)</span> 所在的下标区间 <span class="math inline">\([l,r]\)</span>，初始时 <span class="math inline">\(l=0,r=2187\)</span>。</p>
<p>每次取区间<strong>三等分点</strong> <span class="math inline">\(m_1=l+(r-l)/3,m_2=r-(r-l)/3\)</span>，查询 <span class="math inline">\(S_1=\{m_1,m_2\},S_2=\{l,r\}\)</span>。</p>
<ol>
<li><span class="math inline">\(f(S_1)&lt;f(S_2)\)</span>：<span class="math inline">\(d\)</span> 插在 <span class="math inline">\([l,m_1]\)</span> 段中。</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(f(S_1)=f(S_2)\)</span>：原性质仍然成立，说明 <span class="math inline">\(d\)</span> 插在 <span class="math inline">\([m_1,m_2]\)</span> 段中。</li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(f(S_1)&gt;f(S_2)\)</span>：<span class="math inline">\(d\)</span> 插在 <span class="math inline">\([m_2,r]\)</span> 段中。</li>
</ol>
<p>然后不断三分即可，注意边界和细节问题。</p>
<h2 id="code">Code</h2>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">#include "cake.h"
#include &lt;vector&gt;
#include &lt;numeric&gt;
#define rep(i,a,b) for(int i(a);i&lt;b;++i)
#define per(i,a,b) for(int i(a);i&gt;b;--i)
#define rept(i,a,b) for(int i(a);i&lt;=b;++i)
#define pert(i,a,b) for(int i(a);i&gt;=b;--i)
#define eb emplace_back
using namespace std;
vector&lt;int&gt; bake_cakes(int N,int W,int K){
    if(K==1) return {1,2,3};
    if(K==100){
        vector&lt;int&gt; res(100);
        iota(res.begin(),res.end(),1);
        return res;
    }
    if(K==30){
        vector&lt;int&gt; res(30);
        rep(i,0,30) res[i]=1&lt;&lt;i;
        return res;
    }
    vector&lt;int&gt; res;
    rept(i,1,2187) res.eb(i);
    return res;
}
int find_tastiness(int m,int W,int K){
    if(K==1){
        int k=compare_tastiness({0,3},{1,2});
        return k==-1?3:(k?1:2);
    }
    if(K==100){
        rept(i,0,99){
            if(!compare_tastiness({i},{i+1})) return i+1;
        }
        return 0;
    }
    if(K==30){
        int ans=0,h=-1;
        pert(i,29,1){
            vector&lt;int&gt; t(i);
            iota(t.begin(),t.end(),0);
            if(compare_tastiness(t,{i})==-1){
                h=i;
                break;
            }
        }
        if(h==-1) return 1;
        ans|=1&lt;&lt;h;
        pert(i,h-1,0){
            vector&lt;int&gt; t;
            rep(i,0,30) if(ans&gt;&gt;i&amp;1) t.eb(i);
            t.eb(i);
            int k=compare_tastiness(t,{h+1});
            if(!k) return ans|1&lt;&lt;i;
            if(k==-1) ans|=1&lt;&lt;i;
        }
        return ans;
    }
    int l=0,r=2187,cur=729;
    while(l+1&lt;r){
        int k=compare_tastiness({l+cur,r-cur},{l,r});
        if(k==-1) r=l+cur;
        else if(!k) l+=cur,r-=cur;
        else l=r-cur;
        cur/=3;
    }
    return r;
}
</code></pre>
